svg.aria-label: Case file No. 8283: Rahul L S. Full-stack, cross-platform, AI systems. Thirty-eight tools. Ten of them are databases. No favourites, only a question: what must this remember? Web, mobile, desktop. Same pair of hands. The screen is incidental. He builds what sits behind it. LangGraph. Retrieval. A voice that picks up the phone. He never trusts a model alone. He gives it memory, and a way back.

g.text: There’s no such thing as magic. Only systems, read closely.
what he gives away without saying
